app.name: Protestat
app.tagline: What's happening, from public sources — straight to your phone.
status.browserLimited: In a browser only a few sources can be read. Install the Android app for all of them.
news.emptyEvents: No events found for this filter.
news.emptyAll: No news yet. Tap “Refresh” when you're online.
conf.help: How many independent sources report it. Reposts and likes don't count.
detail.title: Details
detail.automated: Category and place were detected automatically and may be wrong.
reason.independent: {est} established media and {oth} other independent sources report it.
reason.copies: {n} more reports come from the same outlets or are copies — each outlet was counted once.
reason.noDate: No report has a publication date — the time is unknown.
reason.stale: The latest report is {h} hours old. It may no longer be current.
map.nearMeNote: Your location is used once and never stored.
map.legend: Circles show approximate areas, not exact points.
map.empty: No events of these types in the {period}.
map.legendColor: Colour and icon show the type of event.
map.legendNumber: The number shows how many independent sources report it.
map.legendFaded: Faded = older, may no longer be current.
src.title: Sources
add.title: Add source
add.help: Paste a news site link, an RSS feed, or a public Telegram channel (e.g. @name or t.me/name).
add.terms: Respect the site's terms. The app reads it no more than every 15 minutes.
add.fail: Couldn't read it. Check the link or try another page.
link.title: Add a link
link.help: For TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X or videos: paste the post link. It's saved as an unverified report.
share.title: Share with others
share.help: Send collected reports to another phone via Telegram, WhatsApp, Signal or Bluetooth. No account needed.
share.receiveHelp: Open a .protestat file someone sent you.
share.copiesNote: Received reports are marked as “shared” and never raise confidence on their own.
share.suggested: The sender also uses these sources:
share.privacy: The file contains only public news. Never your location, photos or settings.
share.err.not-gzip: This is not a Protestat file.
share.err.bomb: The file looks dangerous and was rejected.
share.err.schema: The file has an unknown format.
share.err.signature: The signature doesn't match — the file may have been altered.
set.wipeConfirm: Delete all reports, your sources and settings on this phone?
set.aboutText: Protestat is free and open source. No server, no accounts, no ads. Everything stays on your phone.
set.safetyText: The app doesn't recognise faces, doesn't track people and doesn't store your location. Gatherings are only shown as approximate areas.
intro.news: Latest events from the news and from people, with how trustworthy each one is.
intro.map: Where things are happening. Choose what to show with the buttons on top.
intro.sources: Where the news comes from and how much we trust it. A = official, B = verified newsroom, C = portal, D = unverified.
intro.share: Send and receive reports with other people, no account and no server.
explain.title: What this means
explain.what.police-presence: police on the ground or a checkpoint
explain.people: {n} people with the app reported {what} near {place}.
explain.onePerson: 1 person with the app reported {what} near {place}.
explain.confirmed: ✅ Confirmed by an official source (e.g. the Police).
explain.peopleOnly: No newsroom or official source has reported it yet. Treat it with caution.
explain.old: ⏳ OLD: the latest report was {ago}. It may be over.
explain.conflict: ⚠️ CAREFUL: some reports contradict it. See details.
explain.ended: 👋 People report it is no longer there.
reason.timeApprox: The site shows no time: it is approximate (when first seen).
reason.people: {seen} different people have seen it (each phone counts once).
reason.goneEnded: {gone} people later reported it is no longer there.
reason.peopleConflict: Conflict: {seen} people see it, {gone} say it is gone.
reason.goneOlder: {gone} people said earlier it was gone, but newer reports say it is there.
reason.peopleLimit: People reports alone never reach "high": someone with many phones could fake them.
reason.newsDisputes: News about {place} at this time contradicts it.
reason.newsAlso: {n} newsrooms also report the same in {place}.
reason.peopleAlso: {seen} people with the app reported something similar nearby.
detail.peopleHelp: Can you see it? Confirm it or say it's gone, so others know how accurate it is.
detail.thanks: Thanks! Saved, and you can share it with others.
report.title: Report what you see
report.step2: 2. Where? Move the map until the marker is on the spot.
report.privacy: Do not write names, number plates or personal details. The spot is rounded to ~200 m.
report.saved: Saved. Share it so others can see it too.
tier.A.desc: The institution speaks for itself (Police, seismologists, municipality). One is enough for "confirmed".
tier.B.desc: Known newsroom, identified owner and journalists, original reporting, corrects mistakes. Each counts once.
tier.C.desc: Mostly reposts, anonymous sources or sensational headlines. Shown, but they weigh little.
tier.D.desc: Sources you add, Telegram channels, social media links and people reports. They do not confirm anything on their own.
tier.note: The ranking is the project's judgement, not a verdict on any outlet. The code is open: you can propose changes.
social.title: Social media (Instagram, TikTok, Facebook)
social.help: These platforms do not allow automatic reading. Open the account, and if you see an important post, copy its link and save it with "Add a link".
more.title: Want more accurate information?
more.text: Get reports from others (.protestat files), turn on more sources, or report what you see yourself.
add.robots: This site does not allow automated reading (robots.txt), so it cannot be added.
